blurb: Guests check in at dawn at Sonoma Skypark for a briefing, watch the balloon inflate, then fly 45–60 minutes over vineyards with views of Sonoma and Napa valleys. Flights include a traditional champagne toast on landing. The company offers shared sunrise flights, private VIP flights, and group events.
extraNote: Reservations required, no walk-ins · Sonoma Skypark, a private airfield in the heart of wine country
